page.notes: The left-margin marks "1." and "2." sit beside "qui comam" and "cōspecti" and are given as notes at those places. Numbers in the text ("1.", "2.", "3.") are paragraph openers and kept as printed. "Obuiet", "veterum", "invicem", "vero", "visi" and "proicit" are written with the u/v and i/j rules applied. The final line continues onto the next page. Hyphens are kept where the printed word breaks at a line end ("pla-netarias", "pla-netam", "im-pediente", "assume-re"). No doubtful readings.
